pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal regions with soft edge gradients. Relative spatial area is maximal at the mid-flank and reduces towards the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage. Pathways show variable pixel thickness, widening towards the lower flank. Junction nodes frequently exhibit tri-radial symmetry.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck ridge, transitioning to a smoother gradient at the shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized linear disruption in the pelage pattern on the posterior flank, suggesting a healed cutaneous lesion.
